patterns.note: Content is presented within a consistent, centered column with generous horizontal padding, creating a focused reading experience across all sections.
Information is organized into clear grid-based layouts, such as a 2x2 grid for feature descriptions and a 3-column grid for blog posts, maintaining visual order.
A single sans-serif typeface is used throughout the site, with hierarchy established through significant variations in font size, weight, and the occasional use of uppercase for labels.
The primary color scheme is a muted, almost monochromatic blend of off-white and black, with subtle, desaturated accent colors appearing primarily within abstract imagery.
The header navigation transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and removing the top announcement banner to become a compact, sticky element.
The large hero image features a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a sense of depth.

technique_notes: A sticky navigation bar is implemented that reduces in height and removes a top announcement banner after the initial scroll, maintaining a compact presence at the top of the viewport.
The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the page content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and alternating background colors, guiding the user through the information hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular-weight body text and very small, uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners universally applied to all elements, including buttons, cards, and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's design stands out with its sophisticated, almost academic aesthetic, achieved through a muted color palette, sharp typography, and a distinctive, abstract hero image that subtly parallaxes. The overall impression is one of serious research and intellectual authority, avoiding common tech-startup visual clichés.
